## Runal 1.2.8

**New: Ban reasons + ClickGUI lockout**
- `/ban <player> [reason]` now takes an optional reason
- Banned players can no longer open the Runal ClickGUI at all - it shows "You are banned from Runal for `<reason>`" instead, no matter how they try to open it (keybind, `/runal`, or the Click GUI module toggle)

**New: Runal Chat ignore list**
- `/runal ignore <player>` - stop seeing a specific player's Runal Chat messages, purely on your end
- `/runal unignore <player>` - undo it
- Saved across restarts

**Improved**
- `/playerlist` now works in any server, not just the bot's home server

## Runal 1.2.7

**New: Runal Chat**
- `/rc <message>` and `/runalchat <message>` - chat with every online Runal player across both ScepterRPG and MageRPG, not just your current server
- Type `#hey guys` straight into normal chat as a shortcut - no need for the full command
- New "Runal Chat" module (on by default) - toggle it off in the ClickGUI if you don't want to see it
- Messages now show which server they came from: `[RC] (ScepterRPG) Name > message`
- Admin-only mute/unmute for keeping the channel usable

**Fixed**
- Waypoint beams are thicker and easier to spot from a distance
- Weapon Cooldown now tracks multi-technique weapons (like Phoenix's Wrath) as separate cooldowns instead of only showing one
- Performance HUD's drag box in the HUD editor now matches its real size, instead of a stale hardcoded one

readmeSummary: Runal brings combat awareness, visual customization, progress tracking, and quality-of-life tools together in one clean ClickGUI.
